en: A fast learner is what ye are, and a good smith to boot. I would sign off on yer work any day of the week. But I sense ye still have some learnin in ye. Go talk to Bengus Deepforge, he's a hard taskmaster but he's also one of the best.
Greetings, little one.  You have business with the Waterlords?
It's time for my meditation, leave me.
No gnome will be left behind.
Not one step closer, ogre!
%s begins to greedily devour the food.
Down goes Frazier!  Down goes Frazier! Down goes...huh?  That wasn't Frazier?

Always a good skill to have that Survival is.

Kaerbrus is who you are looking for. He's usually around the moonwell in the Park.
All right, Reavers!  The orders are here!  To battle!
Disappointing.
Did you forget your student's attire?  Do you think fashion is more vital than the Scourge's domination?
Be gone!  I hold counsel with Dreadlords, and the matters we discuss are not your concern!
It hurts so much... Itharius, my old friend... please help me...

I can see in your eyes you're no stranger to the tragedy within Stratholme. If you wish to end the miserable existence of the poor souls trapped therein, step into the circle. It leads directly to the gates of the burning city itself.

Fancy yourself a chef?  Head to the Undercity south of town for your training.  You can catch the elevators heading down at the back of the Ruins of Lordaeron.  Talk to one of those lumbering Undercity Guardians for further assistance once you arrive.
I've never seen one this size before! I can't wait to send it back for research...
Vanndar Stormpike is the general of the Alliance military in Alterac, and directs his forces from Dun Baldar.$B$BIf he is defeated then the Alliance will surely lose the battle for Alterac.
They almost sent my brother, Loksey, to this gathering. He cannot even take care of his hounds, let alone represent the Scarlet Crusade in a competent manner.
Thank you for the supplies, $n.
That is the wrong answer, $n. Be off with you.
And might I add, that dress is lovely! You must tell me where you got it from.
Behold!  The Blue Recluse holds a feast in $g his:her; honor!
Crush them all!
We're going to have to scratch the Maraudines off our list.  Too hard to work with...
It... it is working!
Then what?
I confiscate the corn he has stolen, warn him that stealing is a path towards doom and destruction, but I let him go to return to his family.
%s faints and falls onto the ground.
Go to the Hunter's Hall in the Valley of Honor, west of the Coliseum.  Talk to Ormak Grimshot there.
That was quite a fight.  Let us catch our breath for a bit.
I would have it back, mortal. Atiesh... From it I would create the Highborne anew. I would have it all back. Even the Queen...
Take me to Eastwall Tower.

Their minds are now tainted, $r. Yes, even more so than before. They live only to serve and protect Razelikh. The amulet fragments they each hold are the key to summoning the demon lord. What you do not understand is that none of them can be harmed through any conventional means

$n!  Our supplies are dwindling and until we get more we can't launch large ground assaults into the Field of Strife!$B$BSpeak with the Stormpike Quartermaster.  He'll tell you what you can do to resupply our assault forces.
